summary: Iteration 202 comprehensive testing complete. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All major features tested and working correctly. Tested Landing page package cards, Workspace dock bar, side panel with drag-to-resize, Bot Store (catalog, install, toggle, config), Channel Tools (templates + webhooks), Team Analytics Dashboard, and mobile responsiveness.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalSelector.jsx: Landing page properly displays all 3 package cards (Standard/Standalone/Enterprise) with proper icons, badges, features, and 'Get Started' buttons. Direct portal links available for returning users.

PortalWorkspace.jsx: Dock bar appears for multi-portal users with portal icons showing Main/Side status. Side panel opens correctly with narrow/wide/half presets. DragHandle between side panel and main content works for custom resize.

BotStoreModal.jsx: Complete bot lifecycle - 8 bots in catalog with category filters, install to channel dropdown, installed tab shows bots with active/paused indicators, config panel with power toggle and editable fields.

ChannelToolsModal.jsx: Two tabs working - Channel Templates (6 templates: Project, Sprint, Incident, Standup, General, etc.) and Webhooks (5 templates: GitHub, Jira, CI/CD, Slack-Compatible, Monitoring). Active webhooks displayed.

TeamAnalyticsDashboard.jsx: Shows stats cards (Channels, Members, Messages, Active Bots), Engagement Score with gradient progress bar (100/100), Top Channels by Activity ranking, Activity Heatmap. Period selector (7d/30d/90d) works.
Mobile responsiveness: Side panel becomes full-width overlay on mobile (width < 768px). Dock bar remains visible. Sidebar adapts to mobile layout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 202 are working. Landing page shows 3 package cards. Workspace dock bar appears for multi-portal packages. Side panel opens from dock clicks with drag-to-resize via DragHandle. Bot Store accessible from ENZI dashboard bento grid - supports full lifecycle (browse 8 bots, install, config, toggle, uninstall). Channel Tools has 6 channel templates and 5 webhook templates. Team Analytics shows channels/members/messages/bots stats, engagement score with progress bar, top channels ranking, activity heatmap. Mobile: side panel becomes full-width overlay.
